notes: Frozen competitor tasks for harness/competitors.mjs (beat-rg-gh PLAN S5).
{{T}} = octocode-local-testing/repos, {{ROOT}} = repo root; shell commands get $T, $ROOT and $CT (scratch dir) and run from the repo root.
Local truth was read from the pinned corpora (see repos/README.md); GitHub truth from gh api / npm / registry JSON at pinned SHAs, numbers and versions on 2026-10-02.

Truth checks (same for both sides): hits = (file suffix, line) pairs that must appear; range = every line start..end present; ranges = list of range; exactHits / exactFiles = set equality; count = distinct (file, line) pairs; files = file suffixes that must appear; text = regexes over model-visible text.

Octocode steps: tool+args (one MCP query), tool+queries (batched rows in one call), raw (root-level args, clasify), cli (CLI-only tools), follow (copy next.<name> verbatim), walk (follow every listed next.* verbatim until exhausted); a step's envelope adds call-level options (e.g. responseCharLength) to its calls. {{prev:a.b}} reads the previous response; {{hint:name.query.x}} reads a continuation field.

Shell parse modes: rg (path:line:text or bare paths), numbered (line[:\t- ]text, with file), sed (unnumbered from start, with file), files (one path per line), filecolon (path: text), diff (diff --git headers), ghsearch (owner/repo:path: text), text (no line evidence).
